_note: All text players see for rp_police. Edit the words on the right side only. Keep every %s: the game fills those in.

command.certs_help: Police: see your division certifications (add an ID to manage an officer's)
command.training_help: Police: see your cadet training (add an ID to sign off a cadet)
command.log_help: Police command: the department log (add an ID for one officer)
command.penalcode_help: Read the San Andreas penal code

error.not_online: Nobody with that ID is in the city.
error.target_not_officer: That person isn't an LSPD officer.
error.too_junior: They need a higher rank before they can hold that certification.
error.not_trainer: Only Field Training Officers and Sergeants (or higher) can sign off training.
error.no_self: You can't sign off your own training.
error.not_cadet: Training is only signed off for cadets.

traffic.label: Traffic Division
traffic.desc: Interceptors and police motorcycles. Speed enforcement and crash scenes.

detective.label: Detective Bureau
detective.desc: Unmarked cars. Follows up on cases, evidence and warrants.

swat.label: SWAT
swat.desc: High-risk warrants and standoffs. SWAT vehicles and heavy gear.

fto.label: Field Training Officer
fto.desc: Trains cadets and signs off their training.

certs.title: Certifications: %s
certs.manage_hint: Click a certification to grant or remove it.
certs.grant_text: Give the %s certification to %s? It unlocks that division's cars and gear.
certs.you_got: You're now certified: %s. Check /certs and the garage.

training.title: Training: %s (%s/%s)
training.sign_hint: Click an item to sign it off (or undo a sign-off).
training.complete: Training complete. Ready for promotion to %s.
training.not_cadet: Training is finished for this officer.
training.sign_text: Sign off "%s" for %s? Only sign what they really did, with you, in the city.
training.you_finished: Training complete! Command has been told you're ready for %s.
training.command_news: Cadet %s has finished training and is ready for %s. A Captain or the Chief can promote them from the boss menu.

orientation.label: Station orientation
orientation.desc: Tour of the station: locker room, armory, garage, evidence, holding cells.

radio.label: Radio and codes
radio.desc: Uses the radio properly: channels, call signs, short clear messages.

rideAlong1.label: Ride-along 1
rideAlong1.desc: A full patrol shift riding with an FTO.

rideAlong2.label: Ride-along 2
rideAlong2.desc: A second patrol shift. The cadet starts taking calls.

rideAlong3.label: Ride-along 3
rideAlong3.desc: A third patrol shift. The cadet leads; the FTO only steps in if needed.

trafficStop.label: Traffic stop
trafficStop.desc: Runs a safe traffic stop: positioning, approach, ID, ticket or warning.

arrest.label: Arrest and booking
arrest.desc: Cuffs, searches, explains the arrest, books and charges using the penal code.

pursuit.label: Pursuit policy
pursuit.desc: Knows when to chase, when to call it off, and how to stop a car safely.

test.label: Final review
test.desc: Passes a short spoken test with an FTO or a Sergeant.

armory.clock_in: Clock in first. Gear is only signed out to officers on shift.

penal.title: San Andreas Penal Code
penal.how_desc: Fines are in dollars. Jail time is in minutes, served while you're in the city. Police can give up to %s minutes in total; anything longer goes to a judge. Only charge what a player actually did.
